description:
The 4StoreyBuilding commercial office model is open in eQUEST. You are a Sustainability Specialist working on a LEED submission. Your goal is to add passive solar shading to the south façade to reduce cooling loads.

Task:
1. Identify all south-facing exterior walls across all floors (Ground, Middle, Top).
2. For EVERY window on a south-facing wall, add a horizontal exterior overhang with the following properties:
   - Overhang A (Distance from window top): 0.5 ft
   - Overhang B (Projection depth): 3.0 ft
   - Overhang W (Extension width): 0.0 ft
3. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to quantify the impact.
4. Save the project.

Note: You must locate the south-facing components in the Building Shell tree yourself. All south-facing windows must be updated.
